Investment pillar 02

Blockchain: infrastructure for an open economy.

Base layers and scaling, decentralized infrastructure, and consumer apps and games.

Our view

Blockchains are becoming shared infrastructure for finance, data and digital ownership. The winners will be the networks and applications that are fast, secure and simple enough that users never have to think about the chain underneath.

Focus areas

Infrastructure for an open economy

01

Base layers and scaling

Networks, rollups and tooling that make blockchains faster, cheaper and easier to build on.

02

Decentralized infrastructure

Storage, compute and networking that replace single providers with open markets.

03

Consumer apps and gaming

Games, social and entertainment that people choose for the experience, not the token.

What we look for

What we look for in blockchain founders

  • Real usage that holds up without incentives.
  • A security model you can explain in plain words.
  • A token, if there is one, with a clear job in the system.
  • A team that ships, and supports its developers and users.
